## Social Fetch - YouTube

Sub-workflow. Called by **Social Daily Report - Orchestrator**.

Credential: **YouTube account** (YouTube OAuth2 API), select it on all 3 HTTP Request nodes after import.

### Flow
`channels.list` (get uploads playlist) -> `playlistItems.list` (get up to 50 recent video IDs) -> `videos.list` (snippet + statistics + contentDetails) -> normalize

`account_id` in Accounts config must be the **Channel ID** (format `UC...`), not the @handle.

`type` is `Short` vs `Video`, classified by duration (<=60s = Short) since YouTube Data API v3 has no first-class "is this a Short" flag.

**Not included yet:** YouTube Analytics metrics (watch time, retention, traffic sources, subscriber growth) require a *second* OAuth2 credential with the `yt-analytics.readonly` scope -- this credential's default scopes don't cover it.
